item.title: Version 2.2.0
item.description:
Added

  • Keyword Impression Share. See Apple Ads impression-share ranges directly in keyword and search-term tables, alongside Rank and Search Popularity. Open any value for its recent trend, coverage details, and last-updated date.
  • Change History. Campaigns, ad groups, and keywords now keep a local history of bid, budget, and status changes. The History inspector includes edits made in ADSwift and changes detected during refreshes from Apple Ads.
  • More control over the sidebar. New View Options let you hide apps and reduce visual clutter while keeping their campaign data available.
  • Clearer drill-down context. Campaign and ad-group screens now show a compact breadcrumb and status strip, making it easier to understand where you are.

Improved

  • RevenueCat revenue loads significantly faster. Cold campaign and ad-group revenue loaded around twice as fast in tested flows. RevenueCat projects can load concurrently, and an ad group you open is prioritized over background work from its campaign.
  • Faster navigation and tables. Opening campaigns, ad groups, keywords, and the inspector now performs less repeated database and layout work, especially while metrics are still streaming.
  • Tables fit their content better. Numeric and supporting columns resize more naturally, keep consistent typography, and avoid oversized or disappearing headers.
  • Impression Share exports. CSV exports can now include impression share, rank, popularity, status, country scope, and the date represented by the report.
  • Clearer account and loading status. Apple Ads connectivity, refresh progress, and RevenueCat loading are now grouped into a cleaner status area.
  • Progressive leaderboard revenue. Ad-group leaderboard rows populate as their revenue becomes available instead of waiting for the entire list.
  • New apps connect to revenue automatically. When possible, ADSwift now finds and preserves the matching RevenueCat project for an app you add.

Fixed

  • More reliable RevenueCat connections. Project mappings are preserved when a token is rejected, unfinished revenue providers no longer appear, and RevenueCat prompts no longer interfere with adding an Apple Ads account.
  • Product Page campaign creation. Creating a Product Page campaign no longer clears its intended targeting.
  • More stable account switching. Campaign groups and account subtrees remain visible and correctly scoped while changing accounts.
  • More dependable table navigation. Fixed disappearing column headers, keyword inspector reset loops, and navigation stalls caused by background metrics updates.
  • RevenueCat guidance stays dismissed. The connection tip no longer reappears after you dismiss it.
